notes.title: The last update for NUMTATE is now live!
notes.content:
Update 2.1 brings a lot of new options, like:
[list]
[*] Hotkeys
[*] Optional font for better readablility
[*] Optional System-Cursor
[*] Own color palette for marking
[/list]
Also, a new tool is now aviable for the level editor: the Fill-Tool!
This should make it easier to fill (or erase) big chunks of your creation and hopefully saves you some time.
The editor also got some new cursors, to show witch tool is currently active.

And at last, the undo and redo buttons can be held. This should make it easier for you, to undo/redo a lot of steps.

With this update, the active development of NUMTATE comes to an end. However, if there are some bugs or mistranslations still in the game, feel free to report them in the community discussions under "Bug Reports & Feedback".

Also, for those who are interested: The old version of NUMTATE (1.1.0) is available as a beta under the name "classic".

I wish you all a nice day!

- Michael Maas

notes.title: NUMTATE - Update 2.0 - New Mechanics, New Look, New Level Editor
notes.content:
[h1]A complete revamp of the game![/h1]
For over one year, I have worked on a complete overhaul of the game. Here is alist of most changes made with this update.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Mechanics[/h2]
Bad mechanics got cut out, good mechanics got improved, new mechanics got implemented.
[h3]Changed Mechanics[/h3]
[list]
[*] There must not be an object on every side of a CORE
[*] CORES (and newly added objects) can now move EVERYTHING; not only CELLS anymore
[*] CORES don't need exactly, but at least, the value displayed on them
[*] Marker-Color can now be chosen by clicking the HUD
[*] Redo-Function got added to the Undo-Function
[*] ...
[/list]
[h3]New Mechanics[/h3]
[list]
[*] CORES can now also rotate counterclockwise with the right mouse button
[*] PUSHER that can push objects in front of them away
[*] MAGNETS that can attract objects in the whole row in front of them
[*] BRICKS are the new 0-Cells
[*] ROTATORS can rotate like CORES, but they don't need CELLS
[*] BATTERYS are basicly CORES that can't rotate
[*] PLATES need something on them to solve the level
[*] Optional marking with patterns, for better visibility
[*] ...
[/list]
[h3]Removed Mechanics[/h3]
[list]
[*] Stop-CORES
[*] CORES in different sizes
[*] </>-CORES
[*] 0-CELLS
[*] "Help-System"
[*] ...
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Visuals[/h2]
The visuals got a big stylish update aswell. Below are some examples:
[h3]Main Menu[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36757492/4a2c463c235d8a3f43dd61b8b36f579f0c69007e.png[/img]
[h3]Level Select[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36757492/14b98a271db9ef13dee4748d0174f883866660ab.png[/img]
[h3]Level 1-1[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36757492/c331765c581bc6b49ddd1b0a33a5fbfc3d04f648.png[/img]
[h3]Options[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36757492/dee3d780fca6f287a67c5a7b958ec43885987cb0.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Level Editor[/h2]
The newly added Level Editor allows you to make your very own custom level packs. Furthermore, you can upload your levels to the Steam Workshop and download and play the levels of other players.
And just in case: you can also export and import levels without the Steam Workshop!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36757492/d4a0af8fa8405cbf5820bdb90b0c8f8c99c2c352.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
I hope this update will improve the experience the players will have with this game. A lot of work was done, but now, I would consider this game finished...

Of course, I will be still there for bugfixes and some minor tweaks or so... but now, I can move my main focus to a new game project, which will be hopefully even better, thanks to everything I have learned during the development of NUMTATE and it's updates.

I wish you a lot of fun with the game and a great day...

- Michael Maas

notes.title: Helping Hand Update (1.1.0)
notes.content:
The update 1.1.0 is now online! 
It adds a lot of qualitiy-of-life improvements, including the new hint-system.
There are also 5 new languages added with this update, so that even more people can hopefully enjoy this game at its fullest.
Furthermore, some crutial and gamebreaking bugs and glitches got fixed. I am very sorry for everyone who had some problems with these. They should be gone now.

I hope you will enjoy this update. More details are below. If you find some bugs, glitches, mistranslations or just have some suggestions, feel free to contact me via mail on: mmaas.games@gmail.com

[b]NUMTATE[/b] Update 1.1.0 Patchnotes:

[u][b]Added[/b][/u]:[list]
[*] Hint system, a colored layer beneath/around the CORES and CELLS, which shows the endpositions of CELLS and/or a way to solve the puzzle
[*] Color-Counter now also shows sum of marked CELLS as if they are all multiplied by 1
[*] Color-Counter now shows number of marked CELLS for each color
[*] Progress on a puzzle will now be saved when leaving the puzzle, so that the player can now continue a puzzle later, without losing progress
[*] 5 new languages: [list]
	[*] german (DEUTSCH)
	[*] french (FRANÇAIS)
	[*] spanish(ESPAÑOL)
	[*] portugese(PORTUGUÊS)
	[*] italian(ITALIANO)
[/list]
[/list]
	
[u][b]Changes[/b][/u]:[list]
[*] Tutorials are now seperated into mutiple pages if necessary with more test objects to test the new mechanics
[*] Color-Counter now also has a black outline at the numbers for better readability
[*] Color-Counter now displays the numbers in a different color, if some multiplied CELLS are marked with its color
[*] Sound now pauses wwhen the game is not on focus
[*] Reset-Button must be hold for a split second to reset the puzzle, which prevents accidental resets by misclicking it
[*] Button sprites are now all in a uniform style
[*] Game now minimize when clicking on a different screen than the game one while the game is fullscreen
[*] Minimal layout changes in following puzzles: 3-3, 4-3, 4-8 and 5-7
[*] Small performance upgrades
[/list]
	
[u][b]Bugfixes[/b][/u]:[list]
[*] Sounds can stack
[*] Rare startup crash
[*] Puzzle 5-8 does not load correctly
[*] Wrong position of the input-info position if the game is not in fullscreen or in 16:9 aspect ratio
[*] Screens blinking on multi-screen-setup when clicking on a different screen than the game
[*] Window centers on the screen every time the game changes the room in windowed mode
[*] CELLS can 'derail' if a CORE was clicked frame perfect to the end of a rewind
[*] GotPoint or LostPoint sounds get played on first rotation of the game, even if they should not
[/list]
